name: factden/hotels-com-reviews-scraper
what_it_holds: Companion Apify actor specifically for Hotels.com: guest ratings, category sub-ratings, review text, owner responses; no login/API key required per description; CSV/JSON/API output.
why_useful: Narrower duplicate of factden's Expedia-Group scraper focused on Hotels.com alone; same rationale (competitor engagement/demand proxy, gap #9), same caveats (live scrape, ToS question, no data committed).
themes: Expedia and Hotels.com datasets (Expedia hotel recommendation Kaggle, personalized ranking ICDM 2013, Expedia scrapers), Trivago RecSys 2019, Kayak/Skyscanner scrapers
Hotel and STR reviews as demand: review velocity datasets (Google, TripAdvisor, Booking) with dates; review-based nowcasting repos
why_all: Narrower duplicate of factden's Expedia-Group scraper focused on Hotels.com alone; same rationale (competitor engagement/demand proxy, gap #9), same caveats (live scrape, ToS question, no data committed).
Additional non-Airbnb review-velocity source for hotel demand nowcasting cross-checks.

name: omkarcloud/expedia-scraper
what_it_holds: Tool for searching airports, comparing flights and hotel fares, and retrieving real-time itineraries/booking links from Expedia; commercial product with a free tier (5,000 requests/month). Last updated 30 Apr 2026.
why_useful: Another live-pull path to Expedia pricing/availability, potentially usable for flight-side travel-demand cross-checks (gap #10 adjacency) as well as hotel ADR proxies; no data committed, requires running against a live commercial site.
themes: Expedia and Hotels.com datasets (Expedia hotel recommendation Kaggle, personalized ranking ICDM 2013, Expedia scrapers), Trivago RecSys 2019, Kayak/Skyscanner scrapers
why_all: Another live-pull path to Expedia pricing/availability, potentially usable for flight-side travel-demand cross-checks (gap #10 adjacency) as well as hotel ADR proxies; no data committed, requires running against a live commercial site.

name: oxylabs/expedia-scraper
what_it_holds: Java-based Expedia scraper (Oxylabs) pulling flights, prices, destinations, and hotel information from the live site. Commercial API wrapper, code examples only, no data committed. Last updated 22 Jun 2026.
why_useful: Third independent live-pull option for Expedia hotel/flight pricing; adds nothing over omkarcloud/expedia-scraper beyond language choice.
themes: Expedia and Hotels.com datasets (Expedia hotel recommendation Kaggle, personalized ranking ICDM 2013, Expedia scrapers), Trivago RecSys 2019, Kayak/Skyscanner scrapers
why_all: Third independent live-pull option for Expedia hotel/flight pricing; adds nothing over omkarcloud/expedia-scraper beyond language choice.

name: jios325/tripadvisor-reviews-scraper
what_it_holds: Small (2-star, 1-commit) MIT-licensed scraper using TripAdvisor's GraphQL API directly (via curl_cffi TLS fingerprinting, no Selenium/Playwright needed) to pull 21 structured review fields (ratings, text, dates, reviewer info, management responses) per hotel. Outputs JSON, CSV, or SQL INSERT statements. No committed sample data; ships proxies.txt.example.
why_useful: Lighter-weight technical route to hotel review counts/dates (review velocity as a demand proxy) than Selenium-based scrapers; still a method, not a dataset.
themes: TripAdvisor datasets: hotel/vacation-rental reviews, review velocity, TripAdvisor rentals, scraper repos
Hotel and STR reviews as demand: review velocity datasets (Google, TripAdvisor, Booking) with dates; review-based nowcasting repos
why_all: Lighter-weight technical route to hotel review counts/dates (review velocity as a demand proxy) than Selenium-based scrapers; still a method, not a dataset.

Lightweight, dependency-free, up-to-date (GraphQL, not scraping rendered HTML) method -- likely to survive longer against TripAdvisor's anti-bot changes than Selenium-based scrapers above. Method only.
Another actively maintained current-day TripAdvisor review pull method (dated reviews), redundant with wow4er's repo but a second working implementation if one breaks.

name: PRO100CHOK/tripadvisor-hotels-reviews-scraper-python
what_it_holds: Python scraper for TripAdvisor hotels, restaurants, attractions and reviews, framed explicitly for 'hospitality compset & review sentiment' use cases; updated 2026-06-06, MIT.
why_useful: Purpose-built for exactly the hotel-compset review-velocity/sentiment use case relevant to a lodging-demand proxy; still unrun/uncommitted data.
themes: TripAdvisor datasets: hotel/vacation-rental reviews, review velocity, TripAdvisor rentals, scraper repos
